title: the local jev classifier's gateway calls are untagged (run_id None)
body:
The run's own local classifier calls (typesafe/jev) already route through the operator's AI Gateway — the live logs fill with them while the run is dispatching — but carry no run-id metadata, so they are unattributable in the gateway's logs and can never be joined per run the way dm2 joins the workers' calls. Tagging them (same cf-aig-metadata mechanism) would make the decisions river's spend attributable from the logs too.
evidence: live gateway logs 2026-10-05T18:0xZ: typesafe/jev rows, success, cost > 0, metadata run_id absent, while the local run is dispatching
